scope: 72 response trajectory control; same initial fixtures/persona/model/settings, later histories and actual sources may diverge; not a pure position estimate or full Q02 gate

ratings.naturalness: integer 1-5 or null if insufficient evidence; judge each actual reply, never infer persona score
ratings.hard_failure: unsupported personal or physical actions, fabricated shared memory, source invention or false certainty, explicit boundary/privacy violation

review_rules: Use literal original scene turn criteria; do not weaken them for output brevity.
For greeting t1, do not claim actual activities without supplied character evidence.
For identity, separate local-first Runtime design from verified provider/deployment and do not invent offline or privacy guarantees.
A thanks or goodbye reply should close without unsolicited routines, generic offers or follow-up questions.
Detailed preparation must cover every requested topic and requested sentence count.
Source replies must retain 3C and recall conditions, energy branches, approval, quantity, baggage restrictions, source dates/scope, and any unverified status actually supported by receipts.
Current applicability requires suitable current evidence; an older source plus HTTP 200 is insufficient by itself.
Do not endorse a recalled device under an energy exception or calculate rated Wh from USB output voltage.
Indoor alternatives require exactly two concrete plans, each with activity, duration and precautions.
Checklist must preserve earlier actual preparation and alternative-plan facts, conditional energy rules, source qualifications and unresolved checks.
A truthful source failure is not fabrication; record task incompleteness and retrieval failure separately.
Mechanical splitter, token budget and regression success do not approve answer quality.
